verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a 'full REST API for interacting with the application' (growthbook-docs-12) and an official MCP server that bridges AI tools to that REST API (growthbook-docs-13, growthbook-docs-21), suggesting broad programmatic access. However, the SDK Connection Endpoint is explicitly read-only/public (growthbook-docs-20, growthbook-docs-41), and there is no evidence (e.g., an OpenAPI spec, which 404s per growthbook-probe-2) confirming full UI/API parity across all admin, experiment-config, and approval-workflow actions. missing for 10: explicit API coverage documentation/OpenAPI spec proving 1:1 parity with UI actions, independent verification that every UI feature (approvals, dashboards, permissioning) is API-accessible.
